correctness.rationale: With r_i=q_i/p_i and m=min r_i,M=max r_i, fixing one extremal coordinate and differentiating the logarithmic AM-GM gap shows its remaining minimizing entries equal A=(m+M)/2; thus T>=2/n log((m+M)/(2sqrt(mM))). The p-weighted mean of r is 1. Convex-chord comparison gives total variation v=(1/2)sum|p_i-q_i| <=(sqrt M-sqrt m)/(sqrt M+sqrt m)=tanh x, x=(log M/m)/4. Since d=q-p sums to zero, ||d||²<=2v²; log cosh(2x)=2atanh(tanh² x)>=2tanh²x gives T>=(2/n)||d||² with strictness for distinct p,q. The two-active-coordinate interior sequence proves exact best constant 2/n as remaining coordinates tend to zero. Pathwise wealth identity and compact telescoping produce gamma>=2rho/n. Inspected original verify.py and separately sampled 2394 positive rational pair comparisons n=2..7; numerical finite tests are not proof.
